checked_core_rules.checked_claim: Anticipated adverse MA medical-necessity determinations require appropriate physician or other licensed professional review with relevant expertise.
checked_core_rules.scope: Core qualification requirement only; integrated-plan exception and actual case applicability must still be checked.

checked_core_rules.checked_claim: MA reconsiderers were not involved in the initial determination; medical-necessity denial reconsideration is made by an appropriately expert physician.
checked_core_rules.scope: Specified MA reconsideration rule; not every product or dispute type.

checked_core_rules.checked_claim: Hospital discharge planning/evaluation is developed by or under an RN, social worker or other appropriately qualified personnel.
checked_core_rules.scope: Hospital discharge-planning qualification requirement only; not sole medical discharge authority.

checked_core_rules.checked_claim: The specified home-health plan is established, reviewed and signed by a physician or allowed practitioner within scope; applicable additions are approved by the referring professional.
checked_core_rules.scope: Core plan/signature and evaluation-addition rule; other order/revision statements retain their separate scope.

limitation: All defined assertion units have scoped authored judgments, with alternatives and unresolved facts. Composite units and explicit models are included; not independent clinical/legal certification.
